basic_details.short_information: Office of the District Programme Officer, Azamgarh (Bal Vikas Seva evam Pushtahar Vibhag, U.P.) Anganwadi Sahayika Notification 2026 has been released on 28 July 2026 on the official website upanganwadibharti.in. A total of 265 vacancies have been announced through the Azamgarh Anganwadi Sahayika Recruitment 2026.

age_limit.details: As per the notification, the applicant's age as on the cut-off date of 1 July 2026 should not be less than 18 years and not more than 35 years.

qualification.details: The minimum educational qualification for the Anganwadi Sahayika post is Intermediate (12th pass) or an equivalent qualification.

selection_process: Selection will be based on a merit list prepared according to the provisions laid out in the relevant government recruitment order. No written examination or interview will be conducted for these posts.
how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted only online through the official departmental website: upanganwadibharti.in
Offline application forms will not be accepted under any circumstances.
Candidates are advised to carefully read the government order and instructions available on the website before applying, to avoid errors.
Applications must be completed before the last date, 31 August 2026, midnight (12:00 AM).
Only the information filled in on the website will be used for the selection process; offline records will not be accepted.
important_instructions: The entire selection process will be governed by the U.P. Government Order dated 17 September 2025. Only female candidates are eligible to apply. Detailed proformas and information are available on the official website and can also be obtained from the concerned Block Child Development Project Office or Vikas Bhawan during office hours. The number of advertised posts is subject to increase or decrease. No written examination or interview will be held; selection is merit-based as per the recruitment order. The Anganwadi Sahayika post is honorarium-based; state service rules do not apply, and services can be terminated as per the provisions of the order at any time.

content_sections.heading: Azamgarh Anganwadi Sahayika Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The notification does not mention the application start date. Candidates should check the official website, upanganwadibharti.in, for this and any date updates.

content_sections.heading: Azamgarh Anganwadi Sahayika Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The 265 posts are distributed across 23 Anganwadi projects (blocks/areas) within Azamgarh district. The project-wise and category-wise breakup is given below. Ward/gram sabha-wise vacancy and reservation details are displayed at the District Collectorate, Vikas Bhawan, Tehsil, Block, and Project offices, and are also available on the official website, upanganwadibharti.in. The number of advertised posts may increase or decrease.

content_sections.heading: Azamgarh Anganwadi Sahayika Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Only female candidates are eligible to apply for these posts. The candidate must be a permanent resident of the ward/gram sabha of the vacant post. If an eligible candidate from the relevant category is not available in that ward/gram sabha, a permanent resident of the concerned Nyaya Panchayat is eligible. content_sections.heading: Documents and Certificates Mentioned in the Notification
content_sections.text: The notification does not provide a complete checklist of application documents, but it specifies the validity of the following certificates where applicable: For widows: death certificate and family register copy issued by the Gram Panchayat Officer or concerned municipal body For divorced/deserted women: a valid legal order issued by a competent court Income, residence, and caste certificates: only those issued online with digital signature by the Tehsil, and verifiable online, will be considered valid Income limit for the below-poverty-line (BPL) category will follow the applicable Samaj Kalyan (Social Welfare) department order Anganwadi Recruitment Jobs

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Azamgarh Anganwadi Sahayika Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted only online through the official departmental website: upanganwadibharti.in Offline application forms will not be accepted under any circumstances. Candidates are advised to carefully read the government order and instructions available on the website before applying, to avoid errors. Applications must be completed before the last date, 31 August 2026, midnight (12:00 AM). Only the information filled in on the website will be used for the selection process; offline records will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions: Azamgarh Anganwadi Sahayika Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The entire selection process will be governed by the U.P. Government Order dated 17 September 2025. Only female candidates are eligible to apply. Detailed proformas and information are available on the official website and can also be obtained from the concerned Block Child Development Project Office or Vikas Bhawan during office hours. The number of advertised posts is subject to increase or decrease. No written examination or interview will be held; selection is merit-based as per the recruitment order. The Anganwadi Sahayika post is honorarium-based; state service rules do not apply, and services can be terminated as per the provisions of the order at any time.

content_sections.heading: District-wise UP Anganwadi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates looking for more opportunities in Uttar Pradesh can also explore the latest UP Government Jobs across various departments. Applicants searching for openings closer to Azamgarh can check Azamgarh District Jobs for upcoming vacancies. Those interested in similar welfare and Anganwadi-related roles can also browse Anganwadi Recruitment Jobs and ICDS Jobs matching their qualification.
